blogs.title: Getting Started with Web Development in 2025
blogs.content: Learn the essential tools and technologies you need to start your journey as a web developer. From HTML basics and modern CSS layouts to advanced full-stack JavaScript frameworks like Node.js and Express. Building projects is the fastest way to gain real-world confidence!
blogs.author: Aman Sharma

blogs.title: UI/UX Design Principles Every Developer Should Know
blogs.content: Understanding design principles can make you a significantly better developer. Explore the key concepts that drive great user experiences, including visual hierarchy, color theory, typography, whitespace, and responsive layouts that delight users across all screen sizes.
blogs.author: Priya Kapoor

blogs.title: Balancing Code and Life: A Developer's Guide
blogs.content: Tips and strategies for maintaining a healthy work-life balance while pursuing your passion in software development. Avoid burnout by establishing clear boundaries, staying physically active, taking regular screen breaks, and pursuing offline hobbies.
blogs.author: Rohit Verma

blogs.title: Responsive Design: Building for Every Screen Size
blogs.content: Master the art of responsive web design with CSS Flexbox, Grid, and media queries. Create layouts that fluidly adapt from mobile smartphones to ultra-wide desktop monitors without sacrificing usability or aesthetic appeal.
blogs.author: Neha Singh

blogs.title: Digital Nomad: Working From the Mountains of Manali
blogs.content: My personal experience of working remotely as a software developer amidst the scenic mountains of Manali. How natural surroundings boost mental clarity, reduce stress, and spark creative problem solving.
blogs.author: Aditya Kumar

blogs.title: AI and the Future of Software Development
blogs.content: How artificial intelligence and generative tools are transforming the way developers write, debug, test, and deploy applications. Learn how to leverage modern AI tools to accelerate your engineering workflow.
blogs.author: Sneha Mishra
